reviews.t: great product for a better price!

All in all, great tattoos for the price, highly recommend.

reviews.t: Loved it. Bought this and another one by the same store.
reviews.x: I loved this set. Wore it to San Francisco Pride, and it lasted me the whole weekend. Had one on my arm and leg. (Koi one is from another pack). On the first day, it looked super shiny and fake but people would ask if it was a fresh tattoo. By the second and third day, it would be matte and it looked so realistic. And it would last up to a week as long as you washed over it without friction. Got a ton of compliments. Kinda easing my mom into letting me get tattoos haha.

reviews.t: WEARS LIKE IRON! (in a good way)
reviews.x: I bought these for a Halloween costume and they were INCREDIBLE. The details were good. I wore the larger skull one on my neck, and my single complaint is that they are very difficult to remove. I tried everything baby oil, warm water, soap, makeup remover, spirit gum remover...on and on...the only thing that worked quickly without scrubbing hard was nail polish remover. Which is horrible for your skin, but I was running out of options. >_<
Got here fast all look amazing only down side is one of tattoos was smaller than the others

reviews.t: Great product, looks real and stays on

The designs are very intricate, they were easy to put on with help from another person, and they looked great and realistic. Mine stayed on for 5 days until I finally used rubbing alcohol and a washcloth to get it to come of. I think it would have stayed on for well over a week if I hadn't done that. I would definitely by this brand again.

I used rubbing alcohol the following morning to remove them and had no issue! I will totally order these again if I ever need them!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the tattoos as realistic-looking and report receiving compliments on them.
Many reviewers praise the durability, noting the tattoos last for days or even a week.
Several reviewers find the tattoos easy to apply.
Some reviewers note the tattoos are difficult to remove, which some consider a positive.
A few reviewers mention size issues, such as tattoos being smaller than pictured or one being smaller than the others.
